scope: EP02 Scene09 low-cost animatic timing plan

rows.animatic_motion: High establishing hold, tiny flag and student movement
rows.dialogue_performance: Manuela: '木制武器。倒地、出界、教师判定，立刻退出。治疗石台是目标。' Hanneman: '我和 Manuela 会负责治疗与裁定。'
rows.sound_bridge: Teacher rule audio starts before cut

rows.animatic_motion: Push down to Byleth's mud map, hand draws the central lane
rows.dialogue_performance: Byleth: '先拿通道。' Felix: '如果机会已经出现呢？' Byleth: '机会不等于命令。'

rows.animatic_motion: Low forward track with Dimitri/Dedue moving away from camera
rows.dialogue_performance: No dialogue; let the horn and first formation movement carry it.
rows.cut_point: Cut as Black Eagles enter same lane

rows.animatic_motion: Ashe high point side/back scan; bow stays low while he checks west thicket and central lane
rows.dialogue_performance: Ashe, low: '明白。' No Golden Deer reveal line yet.

rows.animatic_motion: Side-on controlled first contact, shield/lance stop line
rows.dialogue_performance: Ferdinand: '黑鹫不会被一次冲锋打开！'

rows.animatic_motion: Felix half-step side cut, Byleth voice freezes him
rows.dialogue_performance: Byleth: 'Felix。' Felix: '啧。' Byleth: '等他回身。'

rows.animatic_motion: Support line tracks along wall; Annette/Mercedes stay low
rows.dialogue_performance: Mercedes: '呼吸。跟着老师的信号走。' Annette: '我会跟上。'

rows.animatic_motion: Brief wide setup only: Sylvain/Ingrid right flank prepares for west/left Golden Deer pressure; keep readable weapons as long training lances
rows.dialogue_performance: Sylvain: '也就是说，我们是被人切后路之前的后路。' Ingrid: '少说一句，脚步会更快。'
rows.cut_point: Cut before weapon ambiguity can dominate; detailed Golden Deer flank reveal belongs to Shot029B

rows.animatic_motion: Claude in thicket, eyeline checks Blue rear then Black side
rows.dialogue_performance: Claude: '正面打得这么认真，那我只好帮你们都轻松一点。'

rows.animatic_motion: Claude's first arrow pins Ashe's observation point and forces him off the high mark
rows.dialogue_performance: Ashe: '金鹿在侧面！'
rows.sound_bridge: Arrow hits wood before the line
rows.cut_point: Cut on Ashe leaving the high point

rows.animatic_motion: Hilda, Lorenz, and Ignatz expand Golden Deer pressure from thicket while Claude relocates
rows.dialogue_performance: Sylvain: 'Claude 可真会挑时候。' Ingrid: '他挑的是两边的缝。'
rows.cut_point: Cut on Sylvain/Ingrid turning to contain Hilda/Lorenz

rows.animatic_motion: Two Golden Deer arrows alter both teams' support routes
rows.dialogue_performance: Mercedes: '别停在空地上。' Annette: '右侧也有人！'
rows.cut_point: Cut on Mercedes pulling Annette down

rows.animatic_motion: Byleth crosses Felix's vector side-on, no lecture pose
rows.dialogue_performance: Byleth: '你再走十步，两边都会动。'

rows.animatic_motion: Byleth points two lines: central pressure and side containment
rows.dialogue_performance: Byleth: 'Dimitri，继续压。Dedue，别让口子合上。' Dimitri: '继续？' Byleth: '他们等你回头。别给。'

rows.animatic_motion: Dedue shield dips, Dimitri nearly turns, Mercedes short-heals shield arm, shield rises
rows.dialogue_performance: Dimitri: '杜笃--' Dedue: '殿下，看前面。' Mercedes: 'Dedue，肩膀可以动了吗？' Dedue: '足够。请继续。'
rows.cut_point: Cut when lance line returns forward

rows.animatic_motion: Hubert turns pressure west into thicket; Golden Deer must move
rows.dialogue_performance: Edelgard: 'Hubert。' Hubert: '明白。'

rows.animatic_motion: High oblique compression of three lines, no crowd pile
rows.dialogue_performance: No foreground dialogue; keep distant calls indistinct.
rows.cut_point: Cut when lanes touch central obstacle

rows.animatic_motion: Byleth redirects Blue Lions through chaos toward Black Eagles/Golden Deer overlap
rows.dialogue_performance: Byleth: '不要追金鹿。把黑鹫往他们那边压。'

rows.animatic_motion: Dimitri nears the platform but Byleth's palm-down gesture keeps him from overpressing
rows.dialogue_performance: Heavy breathing; no extra line yet. Byleth's restraint is visual.
rows.cut_point: Cut when Dimitri recognizes the restraint signal

rows.animatic_motion: Byleth points to teacher platform, separate Blue lanes peel off
rows.dialogue_performance: Byleth: '现在。切老师。'

rows.animatic_motion: Ashe lower-left to Hanneman upper-right suppression
rows.dialogue_performance: Hanneman: '哦？先封我的角度。'

rows.animatic_motion: Ingrid lance cuts Manuela's return route without hitting her
rows.dialogue_performance: Manuela: '真是一点都不温柔的学生。' Ingrid: '规则允许。'

rows.animatic_motion: Felix checks Ferdinand at the stair base; neither is knocked out
rows.dialogue_performance: Ferdinand: '让开！' Felix: '你太吵了。'
rows.cut_point: Cut as Ferdinand's route is sealed

rows.animatic_motion: Byleth taps Hanneman's wrist with sheathed blade
rows.dialogue_performance: Hanneman: '判断得很好。'

rows.animatic_motion: Wide de-escalation, weapons lower, teachers off tile; Black Eagles and Golden Deer stand down with dignity
rows.dialogue_performance: Ending whistle; Claude: '真不像第一堂课。' Edelgard: '青狮赢了。但不是因为他们最会冲。'

rows.animatic_motion: Felix close reaction after action; camera-facing now acceptable
rows.dialogue_performance: Felix: '你不是只会碰巧救人。'

rows.animatic_motion: Dimitri lowers lance; hand tension lingers after Byleth already used the restraint command in Shot033/Shot034D action
rows.dialogue_performance: Dimitri: '今日我学到的，不只是战斗方式。'
